note: Brent climbed 3.5% to $94.61/bbl and WTI rose 2% to $83.68/bbl on 25 Nov after Yemen's Houthis said they struck Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and export terminal (CNBC, citing Bloomberg pricing); ISW/CTP assessed satellite imagery as showing a likely hit, though Saudi officials made no public confirmation. Saudi officials separately confirmed a projectile caused minor damage at Jizan port the same day. TTF and JKM eased slightly from 23 Nov; Henry Hub was little changed.
